nodes.text: Explicit version graph flows from app invocation into source-bound Reader validator; absence/mismatch cannot silently pass.

Verified version binding is detached from the actual Validator result and forwarded through graph/security attestation to metadata, with no later producer-state reread; registration hashes fixed generation artifact/code.
Unversioned three-field lineage contexts remain supported without inferring producer paths.

Fifteen synthetic E2E tests traverse real build/publication/query/final gates, with finite fixture model/runtime responses; post-attestation source-state swap cannot change published version metadata.
Missing/wrong binding or failed new build leaves previous published config/index unchanged; human selection followed by source change is held.
This does not approve annual-document version policy, immutable lineage validator behavior, real model/GUI/packaging, or V1 final acceptance.

Six success mocks wrap the identical original lineage state, preserving all assertions. Synthetic temp roots are canonicalized to respect F16. Mandatory Python3.14 schema20 + E2E15 + related15 + counterexamples2 passed; unrelated unsupported Python3.9 baseline error is excluded.
